resources.string: Messages in this chat disappear for everyone after the chosen time — older ones too. The psst server deletes them and the psst apps stop showing them. Anything someone copied, forwarded or photographed in the meantime can\'t be taken back.

The psst Android app blocks screenshots and screen recording in this chat. On iPhone and on the web this can\'t be blocked: the iPhone app hides the chat while the screen is recorded or shared, and when someone takes a screenshot, the others are told. psst for desktop prevents capturing the window where the system allows it. Nothing can stop someone photographing the screen with another device.
Only members allowed to change room settings can change this.
